cards.name: Ampharos
cards.description: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.description: Three Magnemites are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.description: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.description: This upgraded version of Porygon is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.

cards.name: Raikou
cards.description: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

cards.name: Suicune
cards.description: Said to be the reincarnation of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

cards.name: Aerodactyl
cards.description: A vicious Pokémon from the distant past, it appears to have flown by spreading its wings and gliding.

cards.name: Celebi
cards.description: When Celebi disappears deep in a forest, it is said to leave behind an egg it brought from the future.

cards.name: Entei
cards.description: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

cards.name: Ho-oh
cards.description: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.description: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

cards.name: Blissey
cards.description: Anyone who takes even one bite of Blissey's egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

cards.name: Lugia
cards.description: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

cards.name: Raikou
cards.description: A Pokémon that races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.description: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.description: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.description: The center section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.description: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

cards.name: Suicune
cards.description: This Pokémon races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.description: Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.description: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.

cards.name: Celebi
cards.description: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.description: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.description: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depending on how it is feeling.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.description: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.

cards.name: Magcargo
cards.description: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.

cards.name: Octillery
cards.description: It traps enemies with its suction cupped tentacles then smashes them with its rockhard head.

cards.name: Parasect
cards.description: It stays mostly in dark, damp places, the preference not of the bug, but of the big mushrooms on its back.

cards.name: Piloswine
cards.description: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

cards.name: Seaking
cards.description: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

cards.name: Stantler
cards.description: Those who stare at its antlers will gradually lose control of their senses and be unable to stand.

cards.name: Unown [B]
cards.description: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.description: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.

cards.name: Unown [Y]
cards.description: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.description: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.description: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

cards.name: Farfetch'd
cards.description: If anyone tries to disturb where the essential plant sticks grow, it uses its own stick to thwart them.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.description: It uses its arms to steadily climb steep mountain paths. It swings its fists around if angered.

cards.name: Goldeen
cards.description: Its dorsal, pectoral and tail fins wave elegantly in the water. That is why it is known as the water dancer.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.description: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

cards.name: Paras
cards.description: It is doused with mushroom spores when it is born. As its body grows, mushrooms sprout from its back.

cards.name: Quagsire
cards.description: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

cards.name: Qwilfish
cards.description: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

cards.name: Delibird
cards.description: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.description: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

cards.name: Shuckle
cards.description: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

cards.name: Skiploom
cards.description: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

cards.name: Slugma
cards.description: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.

cards.name: Smoochum
cards.description: It always rocks its head slowly backwards and forwards as if it is trying to kiss someone.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.description: It has an active, playful nature. Many people like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.description: At night, the center of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.

cards.name: Swinub
cards.description: If it smells something enticing, it dashes headlong off to find the source of the aroma.

cards.name: Unown [K]
cards.description: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.description: While flying, it constantly emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings.

cards.name: Entei
cards.description: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.

cards.name: Shining Gyarados
cards.description: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

cards.name: Shining Magikarp
cards.description: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions, but never more than seven feet.

cards.name: Ho-oh
cards.description: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent seven colored wings.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.description: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

cards.name: Jumpluff
cards.description: Drifts on seasonal winds and spreads its cotton-like spores all over the world to make more offspring.
